title: 第三十八章 五级秘境
content_zh:
第三十八章 五级秘境-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》

上一章

存书签

下一章

东西都卖光了，爻雪自然也就重新回到了游戏商店之中。

“呼，终于能休息了。”

结果还不等她的屁股跟椅子来了亲密接触，系统就跟鬼一样冒了出来。

【宿主你不会以为任务就这样结束了吧。】

“不然呢？”爻雪说道。

下一秒，系统便毫不留情地打破了她的幻想。

【怎么可能，蓝星那么大，怎么可能只有那些人进入到秘境之中，现在距离下一次强行传送还剩下四小时，请宿主尽快准备】

听到系统这样说，爻雪深吸了一口气，有一句脏话不得不说。

即便是心里再不愿意，爻雪还是起身去做准备了。

之前的异能觉醒药剂那些东西全部都被买走了，所以剩下的物资她还需要重新准备。

好在之前制作药剂的时候并没有将所有的晶核全部用掉，还剩下不少。

剩下四个小时的时间，应该足够她再制作一批异能觉醒药剂了，除此之外，这次她还从秘境中带出了不少好东西，能够制作的药剂就更多了。

幸好之前系统将爻金和爻木两人当做奖励给了她，要不然，她还真忙不过来，毕竟顾了秘境那边，游戏商店这边就顾不过来了。

“爻金，爻木，你们分别让两个分身过来给我帮忙。”爻雪说道。

闻言，爻金问道：“店长，您刚回来就又要出去了？”

爻雪十分命苦的点了点头，“还有任务没有完成，我需要准备一批新的异能觉醒药剂。”

看着爻雪朝着楼上走去，爻金张了张嘴想要说些什么。

在来到蓝星之前，他也见过其他星球的NPC，那些人都表现得十分从容，想要什么物资都能够通过系统直接购买，就算是完成系统发布的任务时也都表现得十分从容，完全没有店长这样一副死了亲爹的表情。

当然，那些人完成任务所获得的积分明面上需要跟系统五五分，但实际上是三七分，宿主三，系统七，但店长这里却是全部的收益都归店长。

相较而言，店长除了累点之外，好像也没有什么坏处。

Everything was sold out, so Yaoxue naturally returned to the game store.

"Phew, I can finally rest."

As a result, before her butt came into close contact with the chair, the system appeared like a ghost.

[Host, you don’t think the mission is over like this.】

"Otherwise?" Yaoxue said.

The next second, the system ruthlessly shattered her fantasy.

[How is it possible? The Blue Star is so big, how is it possible that only those people entered the secret realm? There are still four hours left before the next forced transmission. Please prepare as soon as possible, host]

Hearing what the system said, Yaoxue took a deep breath and had to say a curse word.

Even though she was no longer willing, Yaoxue still got up and made preparations.

All the previous supernatural awakening potions and other items had been bought, so she still needed to prepare the remaining supplies again.

Fortunately, not all the crystal nuclei were used when making the potion, and there was still a lot left.

The remaining four hours should be enough for her to make another batch of power awakening potions. In addition, she also brought out a lot of good things from the secret realm this time, so she can make even more potions.

Fortunately, the system had previously given Yaojin and Yaomu as rewards to her. Otherwise, she would have been really busy. After all, she couldn't take care of the secret realm and the game store.

"Yaojin, Yaomu, please ask two clones to come over and help me." Yaoxue said.

Hearing this, Yaojin asked: "Store manager, you just came back and are going out again?"

Yaoxue nodded bitterly, "There is still a task to be completed. I need to prepare a new batch of power awakening potions."

Seeing Yaoxue walking upstairs, Yaojin opened his mouth and wanted to say something.

Before coming to Blue Star, he had also met NPCs from other planets. They all behaved very calmly. They could purchase any supplies they wanted directly through the system. Even when completing tasks issued by the system, they all behaved very calmly. There was no such expression as the store manager's dead father.

Of course, the points obtained by those people for completing the tasks are apparently 50-50 points compared with the system, but in fact it is 30-70 points, three for the host, seven for the system, but here, all the profits go to the store manager.

In comparison, apart from being a little tired, the store manager doesn't seem to have any disadvantages.
